findings.title: Strategy constructors re-exported by @cipherstash/stack now return Result; documented `authStrategy: X.create(...)` usage breaks on upgrade
findings.label: valid
findings.note: The JSDoc examples and the live lock-context.test.ts still pass OidcFederationStrategy/AccessKeyStrategy.create(...) unwrapped as authStrategy; after the 0.41 bump that hands a Result envelope to newClient.

findings.title: Native-path protect-ffi 0.28 handling of the getToken() Result envelope is unverified
findings.label: unsupported
findings.note: Hypothesizes that protect-ffi 0.28's native newClient may not handle the Result envelope, but nothing in the cited code or repo shows the native binding behaves differently; the risk is unverified rather than demonstrated.

findings.title: Consumers importing the AuthError type from @cipherstash/stack stop compiling
findings.label: trivial
findings.note: Intentional, changeset-documented type rename in a 0.x minor; the compile break is the expected migration.

findings.title: Wizard prerequisites check may throw instead of reporting missing credentials if auth 0.41 failure.type strings differ
findings.label: unsupported
findings.note: Speculative: the changeset itself documents SCREAMING_CASE failure types like NOT_AUTHENTICATED, and the PascalCase value is only a hand-written test mock, so no renamed variant is shown.
